categories.title: Personal Alarm Keychain
categories.description: A compact device that emits an intense 120-130 dB ear-piercing siren upon pulling a pin or pressing a button.
categories.safe_use_notes: Test batteries monthly in an enclosed muffling cloth to prevent auditory discomfort. Keep the pull pin unobstructed and practice activation with one hand.
categories.legal_note: Lawful in all public spaces in India and generally unrestricted worldwide. Does not constitute a weapon.

categories.title: Safety Whistle
categories.description: Pea-less, high-decibel acoustic whistle engineered for long-range audio signaling in urban and remote settings.
categories.safe_use_notes: Wear on an accessible lanyard or exterior zipper loop. Blow in short bursts of three distinct blasts (the universal international distress signal).
categories.legal_note: 100% legal to carry, store, and transport on flights and public transit everywhere.

categories.title: Torch Keyring
categories.description: Ultra-bright compact flashlight with sustained lumen beam and optional high-frequency strobe function.
categories.safe_use_notes: Recharge via USB-C or swap coin cells regularly. The strobe mode can briefly disorient an approaching threat in dark stairwells or poorly lit lanes.
categories.legal_note: Unrestricted everyday illumination tool with zero carriage constraints.

categories.title: Portable Door Alarm
categories.description: Travel security wedge or pressure sensor with integrated loud chime to detect unauthorized door opening in hotel rooms and rentals.
categories.safe_use_notes: Position firmly under the door gap before sleeping. Check rubber footing grip on slick tile flooring.
categories.legal_note: Fully legal travel accessory. Approved for carry-on luggage and checked baggage.

categories.title: Pepper Spray
categories.description: Oleoresin capsicum (OC) canister delivering a targeted spray or stream to cause temporary lacrimation and incapacitation of an attacker.
categories.safe_use_notes: Check canister expiration date annually. Hold canister with thumb over trigger for secure grip. Always be mindful of wind direction before spraying.
categories.legal_note: Rules about carrying pepper spray can differ by place and change over time, so check local regulations before you buy or carry. In India, carriage for lawful self-defense is permitted, but prohibited on flights and inside secured government or transit facilities. Ask a qualified person for legal advice.
